title: Measured observable envelope for full detailed packet validation
failure_signature: Three complete closeout validation attempts exceeded a sixty-second command ceiling despite process batching and object deduplication.
trigger_preconditions: full JSON, privacy, manifest, lifecycle, and Git checks
command ceiling below measured complete runtime
candidate_workaround: Keep the validation set unchanged, run detailed and minimal separately, and use a 180-second command envelope with progress yields no longer than thirty seconds.
recurrence_guard: Measure full-packet runtime after structural optimizations and size only the execution envelope; never delete or narrow checks merely to avoid a timeout.
rollback: Retain all three timeout negatives and both failed witnesses; if the larger envelope still fails, decompose receipts without changing their combined check set.
scope_boundary: Execution-envelope sizing only; the full check set and all evidence gates remain unchanged.
